38497.synonym: ṭhapayi, ṭhapesi, nivesayi, patiṭṭhapesi, saṇṭhapesi, saṇṭhāpesi

examples.text: bhavametaṃ ānando jāneyya, yesaṃ so bhavaṃ gotamo dhammānaṃ vaṇṇavādī ahosi, yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.

38498.meaning1: (of the knee) dropping; lowering; touching the ground
38498.commentary: (THIa) nihacca jāṇuṃ vanditvā'ti jāṇudvayaṃ pathaviyaṃ nihantvā patiṭṭhapetvā pañcapatiṭṭhitena vanditvā.

examples.text: nihacca jāṇuṃ vanditvā, sammukhā añjaliṃ akaṃ, ehi bhadde'ti maṃ avaca, sā me ās'ūpasampadā.
arahante sītībhūte, katakicce anāsave, nihacca mānaṃ athaddho, te namasse anuttare'ti.
